question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Modest
solution:
The correct answer is: **Demure**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Modest **means having or showing a moderate estimation of one's own abilities, achievements, or worth; not boastful or excessively proud. (आडंबरहीन)

 
 
• **Example**: *Despite his success, he remained modest and never boasted about his accomplishments.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Demure <
